description_sq:
Toke per shitje me leje ndertimi per vile ose bujtine prane fermes 100.
Toka eshte 3500 m2 me dokumentacion te rregullt, eshte toke shesh dhe ndodhet buze rruge kryesore.
Zona ne te cilen ndodhet toka eshte nje zone e cila frekuentohet shume per shkak te bizneseve te restoranteve qe ka, pasi njihet si zone per ushqim tradicional dhe bio.
Toka zoteron leje ndertimi te aprovuar nga bashkia tirane, ne te cilen mund te ndertohet vile ose bujtine.
Vendndodhja e prones eshte 10 minuta larg qendres tregtare TEG.
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni.
title_en: Land for sale with building permit!
description_en: Land for sale with a building permit for a villa or guest house near the farm 100. The land is 3500 m2 with regular documentation, it is a square land and it is located on the edge of the main road. The area in which the land is located is an area that is frequented a lot because of the restaurant businesses it has, as it is known as an area for traditional and organic food. The land has a building permit approved by the municipality of Tirana, on which a villa or guest house can be built. The location of the property is 10 minutes away from TEG shopping center. For more information, contact us.
